indicators.label: Drought proneness
indicators.rationale: Frequent drought incidence implies riskier agriculture.

indicators.label: Flood proneness
indicators.rationale: Larger flood-susceptible area implies more land under risk.

indicators.label: Earthquake proneness
indicators.rationale: Earthquake-prone areas risk crop, livestock and infrastructure damage.

indicators.label: Forest fire proneness
indicators.rationale: Forest fires can spread into farmlands, destroying crops and infrastructure.

indicators.label: Cyclone proneness
indicators.rationale: Cyclones bring strong winds, flooding, and saline intrusion that degrade soil.
